description: 한국도로공사_교통량 변화 발생구간 설치된 차량검지기(VDS) 정보 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국도로공사. 본 데이터는 한국도로공사가 관리하는 교통량 변화 구간의 차량검지기 설치 정보를 제공한다. 고속도로 상에서 교통량이 급변하는 지점을 파악하기 위한 기초자료로 활용된다. The portal shows 2025-07-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
